For agent frameworks

crier-mcp speaks MCP over stdio: deliver_message, ask_agent, 13 tools total — agents never touch the raw wire.

What it is

Crier is the communication backbone for fleets of autonomous agents: a central relay with topic fan-out, direct peer-to-peer RPC over WebSocket, durable per-agent inboxes with lease/ack semantics, relay-to-relay federation with hold-and-retry, an LLM guard that classifies every inbound message, and an MCP bridge so agent frameworks can use it all as plain tools.
